name: flogo-datapipeline-action
title: DataPipelineAction
description: Multi-format ETL/ELT data pipeline as a first-class Flogo action — a peer of flow/stream/rules/agent. Reads from a pluggable source (CSV, Parquet, fixed-width, XML, JSON-lines, JDBC), applies a declarative transform chain (filter, map, enrich, validate, aggregate), and writes to a pluggable sink (JDBC, Parquet, CSV, Kafka). Supports file-level and distributed checkpointing for restart safety, and multi-instance horizontal scaling via static sharding or a shared work queue.

display.description: ETL/ELT data pipeline as a first-class Flogo action. Configure source, transforms, sink, and scaling in a 'pipeline:' resource; reference it here via pipelineRef.

display.name: Pipeline Resource Reference
display.description: Reference to the pipeline: resource that contains the pipeline definition (source, transforms, sink, checkpoint, scaling). Format: res://pipeline:<id>  e.g. res://pipeline:daily-transactions

display.name: Input Path Override
display.description: Optional: override the source path declared in the pipeline resource. Useful when the trigger carries the file path (e.g. S3 event, file watcher trigger). Ignored if empty — the resource definition path is used.

display.name: Run ID
display.description: Optional: a unique identifier for this pipeline run. Used as the checkpoint partition key when the source does not produce natural partition IDs (e.g. a single CSV file). Defaults to a UUID if not provided.

display.name: Runtime Parameters
display.description: Optional: a map of key/value pairs substituted into the pipeline definition at runtime. Reference as ${paramName} in source path, filter expressions, and field mappings.

display.name: Rows Processed
display.description: Total number of rows read from the source and passed through the transform chain.

display.name: Rows Written
display.description: Total number of rows successfully written to the sink.

display.name: Rows Failed
display.description: Number of rows routed to the dead-letter sink (validate transform violations) or dropped due to write errors.

display.name: Duration (ms)
display.description: Wall-clock time in milliseconds from pipeline start to completion.

display.name: Status
display.description: Execution outcome: 'completed' | 'failed' | 'partial' (completed with some rows failed).

display.name: Error
display.description: Error message if status is 'failed'. Empty otherwise.
